sentences.pinyin: Zhège pánzi hěn gānjìng.
sentences.english: This plate is very clean.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ pánzi fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
sentences.english: Please put the plate on the table.

sentences.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn pàng le yìdiǎnr.
sentences.english: He has got a little fatter recently.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè zhī māo yòu pàng yòu kě'ài.
sentences.english: This cat is both chubby and cute.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē yì bēi píjiǔ.
sentences.english: I would like a glass of beer.

sentences.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ hái yǒu liǎng píng píjiǔ.
sentences.english: There are still two bottles of beer in the fridge.

sentences.chinese: 他买了一双黑色的皮鞋。
sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yì shuāng hēisè de píxié.
sentences.english: He bought a pair of black leather shoes.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shuāng píxié bú tài guì.
sentences.english: These leather shoes are not too expensive.

sentences.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí gè kōng píngzi.
sentences.english: There is an empty bottle on the table.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ píngzi lǐ de shuǐ hē wán.
sentences.english: Please finish the water in the bottle.

sentences.chinese: 其实我不太喜欢喝咖啡。
sentences.pinyin: Qíshí wǒ bú tài xǐhuan hē kāfēi.
sentences.english: Actually, I don't really like drinking coffee.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí qíshí hěn jiǎndān.
sentences.english: This question is actually very simple.

sentences.chinese: 其他同学都已经回家了。
sentences.pinyin: Qítā tóngxué dōu yǐjīng huí jiā le.
sentences.english: The other classmates have all gone home.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ hái yǒu qítā de wèntí ma?
sentences.english: Do you have any other questions?

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān qí zìxíngchē shàngbān.
sentences.english: I ride a bicycle to work every day.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bú huì qí mǎ.
sentences.english: He cannot ride a horse.

sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: Today's weather is very strange.

sentences.chinese: 他说的话让我觉得很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà ràng wǒ juéde hěn qíguài.
sentences.english: What he said struck me as very strange.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān liù diǎn qǐlái.
sentences.english: I get up at six every day.

sentences.pinyin: Tiānqì rè qǐlái le.
sentences.english: The weather has started to get hot.

sentences.pinyin: Fēijī mǎshàng jiù yào qǐfēi le.
sentences.english: The plane is about to take off.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen de fēijī bā diǎn qǐfēi.
sentences.english: Our plane takes off at eight.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shuō de qīngchu yìdiǎnr.
sentences.english: Please speak a little more clearly.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi tīng qīngchu tā de míngzi.
sentences.english: I didn't catch his name clearly.

sentences.pinyin: Tā jīntiān shēngbìng qǐngjià le.
sentences.english: He was ill and took leave today.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐngjià yì tiān.
sentences.english: I would like to ask for one day off.

sentences.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì hěn shūfu.
sentences.english: Autumn weather is very pleasant.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan qiūtiān.
sentences.english: Autumn is my favourite season.

sentences.chinese: 她穿了一条红色的裙子。
sentences.pinyin: Tā chuān le yì tiáo hóngsè de qúnzi.
sentences.english: She wore a red skirt.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qúnzi tài cháng le.
sentences.english: This skirt is too long.

sentences.chinese: 我先写作业，然后看电视。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiān xiě zuòyè, ránhòu kàn diànshì.
sentences.english: I do my homework first, then watch TV.

sentences.chinese: 我们先吃饭，然后去公园。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān chīfàn, ránhòu qù gōngyuán.
sentences.english: We eat first, then go to the park.

sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de fúwùyuán hěn rèqíng.
sentences.english: The waiters here are very warm.

sentences.pinyin: Tā rèqíng de huānyíng wǒmen.
sentences.english: He welcomed us warmly.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi zhège bànfǎ hěn hǎo.
sentences.english: I think this method is very good.

sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu rènwéi tā shì duì de.
sentences.english: Everyone thinks he is right.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xuéxí fēicháng rènzhēn.
sentences.english: She studies very earnestly.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng rènzhēn tīng lǎoshī jiǎngkè.
sentences.english: Please listen to the teacher carefully.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí hěn róngyì.
sentences.english: This question is very easy.

sentences.pinyin: Xué Zhōngwén bù róngyì.
sentences.english: Learning Chinese is not easy.

sentences.chinese: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
sentences.english: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

sentences.chinese: 如果你有时间，请给我打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu shíjiān, qǐng gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
sentences.english: If you have time, please give me a call.

sentences.chinese: 外面下雨了，别忘了带伞。
sentences.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià yǔ le, bié wàng le dài sǎn.
sentences.english: It's raining outside, don't forget to take an umbrella.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè bǎ sǎn shì wǒ de.
sentences.english: This umbrella is mine.

sentences.chinese: 我每天晚上上网看新闻。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān wǎnshang shàngwǎng kàn xīnwén.
sentences.english: I go online every evening to read the news.

sentences.pinyin: Zhèlǐ kěyǐ shàngwǎng ma?
sentences.english: Can I get online here?

sentences.pinyin: Māma shēngqì le.
sentences.english: Mum got angry.

sentences.chinese: 你别生气，我不是故意的。
sentences.pinyin: Nǐ bié shēngqì, wǒ bú shì gùyì de.
sentences.english: Don't be angry, I didn't do it on purpose.

sentences.pinyin: Tā de shēngyīn hěn hǎotīng.
sentences.english: Her voice is very pleasant.

sentences.chinese: 请把电视的声音关小一点儿。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ diànshì de shēngyīn guān xiǎo yìdiǎnr.
sentences.english: Please turn the TV volume down a little.
